content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Zilla Swasthya Samiti Rayagada (ZSS Rayagada), a government body responsible for health services in the Rayagada district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for various posts, including Physiotherapist, Psychiatric Nurse, Block Accounts Manager, Senior Technical Supervisor (STS), and Community Supervisor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the ZSS Rayagada recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What are the eligibility criteria for the posts?
faq.answer: The specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications and experience, are detailed in the official notification. Candidates are advised to refer to it.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit details for all posts are available in the official notification. Candidates should check the notification for specific age requirements and any applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue for the Walk-in Interview is Zilla Swasthya Samiti Rayagada, located in Rayagada, Odisha, with pincode 765002.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on incumbency and applicable reservation categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for more details.
